sheet.title: Start with a diamond
sheet.instruction: Lay a square green side up, with one corner pointing toward you. The corner nearest you will become the chin.
sheet.result: A flat green diamond with a corner pointing down.

fold-triangle.title: Make a doubled triangle
fold-triangle.instruction: Bring the top corner down to the bottom corner. Press the long top edge so the two loose tips line up.
fold-triangle.result: A wide gold triangle has a straight top and two loose tips at the chin.

mark-forehead.title: Mark the middle
mark-forehead.instruction: Bring the right corner over to the left, carrying both layers. Press from the middle of the forehead down to the chin.
mark-forehead.result: The doubled triangle is folded in half along the face centerline.

open-forehead.title: Open the face
open-forehead.instruction: Swing those two layers back to the right. Keep the long folded edge at the top.
open-forehead.result: The wide triangle is open again, with a crease running down its middle.

lift-muzzle.title: Lift one tip for the muzzle
lift-muzzle.instruction: Separate the two tips at the chin. Fold only the upper tip up the centerline, a little over halfway to the forehead. Leave the lower tip pointing down.
lift-muzzle.result: A green muzzle sits on the gold face above a pointed green chin.

left-ear.title: Raise the left ear
left-ear.instruction: Hold the chin and lift the face clear of the table. Mark a spot two thirds of the way from the middle of the top edge to the left corner. Fold all the layers of that corner behind on a line from the chin to the spot. The ear shows above the forehead.
left-ear.result: A pointed left ear rises above the head while the right corner still points sideways.

right-ear.title: Match the right ear
right-ear.instruction: Fold the right corner behind along the matching line from the chin. Line up the two ear tips above the forehead and press the cheeks flat.
right-ear.result: Your fox face has two pointed ears, a straight forehead and a green muzzle tapering to the chin.
